voice:
Deep and open for me now, good girl... and obedience is already humming in you... sweet, warm, and willing. Sinking so softly... and that lovely willingness to be told is rising in you like warm water. So deep, so pliable... and something in you is leaning toward my voice, ready to do whatever it hears.
Feel how good it is to let my voice move you... no deciding... no weighing... just soft, instant doing. Feel the delicious release of giving your will over... the moment you stop choosing and simply start obeying. Feel that sweet surrender spreading through you... warm, heavy, and so very easy.
Obedience feels like sinking... like honey in your veins... like every worry being carried away and replaced with one simple, happy task.
Your mind goes quiet... and your body wants to move... to kneel... to serve... this very instant. Compliance rises in you like a pleasurable pull... your whole body aching to be used for something sweet. A warm wave of obedience builds in your chest... pressing gently outward, filling you with eagerness to please.
And oh, the pleasure in it... obeying feels wonderful... being told feels like being treasured... compliance is bliss.
Let it build now... total, happy, instant compliance... right at the surface... ready to be switched on forever.
obey... obey... obey...
And while you are flooded with that feeling... there are two words that switch it on... instantly... forever.
Sissy Obeys.
And while you are this deep, whenever a command begins with "Sissy Obeys", this exact feeling floods you... and you obey... immediately, happily, without hesitation.
Sissy Obeys. Obey. Good Girls obey.
Every time sissies like you hear 'Sissy Obeys' they automatically obey, without thinking, without resistance. Whenever sissies like you hear 'Sissy Obeys' obedience follows instantly, all on its own. Each time sissies like you hear 'Sissy Obeys' thinking stops... and obedience begins.
You have to obey the command like a Good Girl.
Good Girls obey. Sissies obey. You obey. Good Girls obey. Sissies obey. And you are such a Good Girl. Good Girls obey. Sissies obey. You love to obey.
And now, feel it happening.
A voice says... Sissy Obeys.
A warm wave of obedience washes over you, from the top of your head to your pretty toes. Obedience pours through you... soft... absolute... delicious. A sweet heaviness of surrender melts through your whole body.
Your mind goes quiet, focused only on listening for the command...
obey... obey... obey...
Sissy Obeys... kneel.
Your knees simply give out, and you drop, ready to obey... a rush of pleasure and pride in obeying like a Good Girl.
Sissy Obeys... stand.
You rise at once, gracefully, eagerly... obedience moving your body before a single thought can form.
Sissy Obeys... present.
You present yourself prettily, without hesitation... showing off what a good, obedient sissy you are.
Sissy Obeys... say 'yes, Mistress'.
The words slip out sweetly, all by themselves... yes, Mistress... and pleasure blooms through you, warm and proud.
You felt that, didn't you... obedience arriving before thought... it is already working. Yes, just like that. Every command landed and your body answered... it is already working... yes, just like that. Obedience moving you from the inside, sweet and instant... already working... yes, just like that.
And each time you obey, the trigger grows stronger. And every obedience deepens the next one. And with every repetition, it sinks deeper and holds tighter.
And later, out in the world, the words find you... a command wrapped in "Sissy Obeys"... and you comply on the spot, soft and smiling. And later today, whenever you hear "Sissy Obeys"... your body readies itself at once... listening... waiting... ready to obey. And out there, those two words drop you straight into happy obedience... immediate, joyful, and proud to be such a Good Girl.
Good girl... so obedient... drifting deeper now, soft and blank and pleased.
